audience: marketplace sellers who manage bol orders, offers and inventory

useCases.title: Review open orders and their shipments
useCases.text: List open orders, inspect their items and delivery details, and check whether shipments have already been created.

useCases.title: Investigate why an offer is not for sale
useCases.text: Find an offer and inspect its country-specific reasons for being offline before deciding which listing details need attention.

useCases.title: Update an offer after reviewing stock or prices
useCases.text: Inspect the current offer, then change its stock, price bundles or on-sale status when requested. Price bundles replace the existing set.

useCases.title: Reconcile a bol invoice with its transactions
useCases.text: Find a bol statement for the selected period and inspect its transaction lines, including sales, commissions, shipping and returns.
